text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Community Disputes Resolution (Retention and Disposal of Instruments and Objects) Regulations 2025 and come into operation on 7 April 2025.

heading.en: Disposal of instruments or objects seized or removed

text.en:
3. When investigations involving an instrument or object seized or removed under section 13L(7) of the Act have been concluded, or at any other time that the Director‑General thinks appropriate, the instrument or object may be —
(a)returned to the person from whom it was seized or the place from which it was removed; or
(b)destroyed or otherwise disposed of in any manner that the Director‑General thinks fit.
